name: Chenthuran aka Chen
title: Senior Product Designer — design systems and complex enterprise products
about: Senior Product Designer with 10+ years of experience, working on design systems, developer platforms and complex enterprise products. Hands-on individual contributor: he untangles how these systems actually work, then helps the people who use them find a simpler way through.
expertise: 1. Design Systems & Platform Work — Builds systems that settle the common decisions once, so teams don't re-make them every sprint. Also does the harder half: getting people to actually adopt them. Cut component assembly time from 20 minutes to under 5.
2. Enterprise & Developer Tools — Simplifies internal tools that usually get no research budget and no polish, turning high-touch setup into self-service workflows engineers can run themselves.
3. Complex Systems & Fintech — Maps multi-party systems (lending flows on distributed ledgers, processes held together by spreadsheets and workarounds) and finds the version a non-expert can follow.
4. AI & Agentic Design — Designs AI tools that show their working, so the person using them can tell when to trust the output and when to go and check it.
highlights: - 5 awards: 2x Manager Spotlight Award, 2x Star Award (Employee of the Year), 1x iDesign Award (brand and print)
- Component assembly time cut from 20 minutes to under 5 through a design system rebuild, owned solo with no dedicated engineering support
- Onboarding lead time cut 65% and integration bugs 35% on an enterprise developer platform
- Domains worked in: Fintech, DeFi/DLT, Enterprise SaaS, Developer Tools, Banking, Healthcare, Government, Gaming
key_projects: 1. Transforming a Design System — Rebuilt an internal product design system into a prescriptive platform, cutting component assembly time from 20 minutes to under 5 minutes. Ran it solo: the research, the component architecture, and the ongoing upkeep, with no dedicated engineering headcount on the design side.

2. Horizon Bank Developer Central — Unified a bank's fragmented internal developer tools into one self-service portal, cutting onboarding lead time 65% and integration bugs 35%. A later AI phase (code generation and smarter search) is piloted, with projected figures rather than production-measured ones. Client anonymised under NDA.

3. DOSB Financing Ecosystem — Designed a distributed-ledger capital bridge for diverse-owned small business lending, including the Global Pass identity credential and a proxy voting system built into the dashboard. Currently in pilot; results are projected from prototype usability testing, not yet measured in production. Client anonymised under NDA.
4. Idea Godown — A repository of self-directed side projects and hardware/software experiments, including ideas he decided not to pursue and one archived because someone else solved it first.
beyond_bau: 1. Comment Analyzer Plugin: Figma plugin that reads design-review comments and sorts them into bugs, copy fixes and questions, cutting triage time 40%.
2. Design Decision Log: Figma plugin that captures decision rationales on canvas and syncs them to Notion and GitHub via webhooks.

3. Design System Research: A self-initiated research sprint with 12 designers across India and the US, timing them on complex component tasks such as tables. It became the evidence base for the Transforming a Design System case study.
4. Team Personality Workshop: Facilitated a workshop for 20 people based on the book Surrounded by Idiots, mapping how each person prefers to be communicated with to reduce friction in critiques.
5. Design System Assistant Agent: AI copilot for design tokens, content rules, and accessibility specs; tested with 10 designers, saving 30% of their time on findability tasks.
